work.title: Declarative source registry validation and compilation
authority: Direct user request to implement a minimal declarative source registry, schema, and deterministic validation tests

intent.productGoal: Preserve governed source provenance and admissibility before analytical intake without making acquisition part of the analytical engine.
intent.capability: Validate and deterministically compile a versioned source registry into a frozen, local intake manifest.
architecturalIntent: Registry validation and compilation are standalone offline scripts.
Acquisition, rights resolution, and network access remain outside the analytical engine.
Population-specific routing remains declarative and preserves independent control populations.
invariants: The registry module makes no network requests.
Only explicitly ingestible artifacts resolve into an intake manifest.
Registry policy never creates balancing entries or alters canonical financial calculations.

decisions.decision: Place registry compiler and validator under root scripts rather than analytical core.
decisions.rationale: Preserves the boundary that the analytical engine consumes resolved local artifacts only.

decisions.decision: Use an immutable snapshot ID and deterministic compiled-policy hash.
decisions.rationale: Makes registry selection auditable and stable across ordering changes.

observedBehaviour: The canonical registry validates and compiles to SHA-256 9651d7a218644fbb69916375ba26900e2c4bfeafc9f46fd065a98fe31224ce12.
Six offline registry tests passed, including rejection of rights/custody conflicts, dangling adapters, unknown routed artifacts, non-ingestible artifacts, and network-enabled adapters.
Full test suite and typechecks passed.

evidence.result: 31 core tests and 6 registry tests passed.
Core TypeScript and workbench checks passed.
Canonical registry validates offline with a deterministic compiled-policy hash.

divergences.expected: A Drive-authoritative source register with durable acquisition receipts.
divergences.observed: This repository implementation contains only controlled metadata and no acquisition/custody executor or Drive synchronization.

learning.recurringPattern: Source filenames and run hashes alone do not govern rights, custody, or adapter authority.
learning.improvementProposal: Add a separately authorized registry snapshot publication and receipt-binding workflow outside the analytical engine.
durableKnowledge: Registry snapshots should be immutable evidence bindings.
CI/acquisition recipes are not proof of durable custody without an independently recorded durable location and receipt.
